description: Returns the latest monthly Wire: loans transferred to or returned from special servicing, newly delinquent, moved deeper into delinquency, new appraisal reductions, liquidations with losses and special servicer updates, largest first. Use section to fetch one list. Use it for what changed this month; use distress_index for rates and trends and search_loans for a loan's current state. Comment excerpts are included only with a key.

limit.description: Items per section: default 10 without a key and 25 with one; up to 25 without a key and 400 with one

name: wire

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation wire). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

asOf.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the loan data behind this issue is as of.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

capped.description: Free plan only: true when a section has more items than were returned and the limit asked for was the plan maximum.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

month.description: The Wire issue's month (YYYY-MM): the month of asOf.

note.description: Present with capped: sentence stating the plan's list limit.

proFields.description: Free plan only: names of item fields left out of this answer.

sections.description: The issue's sections, in fixed order; only the one asked for when a section filter is sent.

balance.description: Sum of the balances of all the section's items, whole dollars.

count.description: Number of items in the section before the plan's limit is applied.

items.description: The section's items, largest balance first, cut to the limit (default up to 25).

summary.description: Headline counts and rates for the month.

dlqRate.description: Delinquency rate from the distress index's newest month, a fraction of 1 (0.04176 = 4.176% of balance).

returns.description: Count of loans returned to the master servicer this month.

ssRate.description: Special servicing rate from the distress index's newest month, a fraction of 1 (share of balance with the special servicer).

transfersIn.description: Count of loans that transferred to the special servicer this month (the transfers section's count).

url.description: URL of the Wire page on cmbs.news.

title: This month in CMBS
